tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Use when an agent wants to browse, filter, or search prediction-market events across all 8 platforms. Returns paginated events, each with its leading outcome, that outcome's price and the event's 24h volume, plus platform metadata and `pdata_url`; call `get_event` for the markets. Filterable by sour

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the full detail of a single prediction-market event by its composite key (source + event_id). Returns the event with all of its child markets, latest probabilities, and metadata. The canonical URL `https://pdata.world/events/{source}/{event_id}` is stable for the lifetime of

tools.name: get_event_brief
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the current state of one prediction-market event without every field of every market: the compact form of get_event. Returns the title, venue, status, close time, the event's volume with its unit, and up to 20 outcomes (by price when they are mutually exclusive, else by volum

tools.name: get_event_similar
tools.description: Use when an agent needs events similar to a given event — cross-platform equivalents and topically-related markets, precomputed nightly from title embeddings. Best-first; empty list (never an error) when no similarities are known yet.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Use when the user wants to browse, filter, or sort individual markets (not events). Returns paginated markets with their probability, volume, source, parent event ID, and 24h delta. Filterable by source, country, category, status, and full-text `search`. Sortable by `volume_24hr` or `probability`. C

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the full detail of a single market by its composite key (source + market_id). Returns the market with its parent event reference, current probability, volume, 24h delta, and historical chart points. Includes a `_meta.cite_as` field that the agent can drop directly into its re

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: Use when the user wants the largest probability moves of the last 24 hours right now, one market per event, ranked by the size of the move alone; for the news feed of spikes inside a 2, 12 or 24-hour window scored by size and volume use `list_news_movers`, and for that feed by category `news_movers_

tools.name: closing_soon
tools.description: Use when the user wants to see markets that will resolve within the next 36 hours. Returns markets sorted by close timestamp ascending. Takes the /markets filters, e.g. `source=` and `categories=` (CSV); price-derivative markets are included unless `hide_price_derivatives=true`.

tools.name: search_suggest
tools.description: Use when an agent has a name or phrase and needs the `(source, id)` of the matching event or market before calling another tool. Resolves free text against events AND markets in one call, best-first, and reports `total_events` / `total_markets` so the agent can tell a precise hit from an ambiguous o

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Use when an agent needs platform-level context before drilling into individual markets: one row per platform (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, Myriad, Limitless, Predict, Opinion, Gemini) carrying 24h volume in each venue's own unit, active event and market counts, and that platform's category mix. Tak

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the list of country tags that markets have been tagged with. Returns the canonical country vocabulary with per-country market counts. Accepts the same filter params as `list_markets` (source, category, status, volume/probability ranges, search, …): the counts then reflect tha

tools.name: list_news_movers
tools.description: Use when the user wants the news-feed view: markets whose probability spiked inside a 2, 12 or 24-hour window, scored by size of move times volume and grouped by event and topic; for a plain 24h ranking by size of move use `top_movers`, and for this feed grouped by category `news_movers_by_category`

tools.name: news_movers_by_category
tools.description: Use when the user wants the same feed as `list_news_movers` pre-grouped into 13 categories (pdata's 14 less Mentions, which the feed excludes), as in 'what is moving in politics?'; for one ranked feed use `list_news_movers`, and for a plain 24h ranking by size of move `top_movers`. Returns the same

tools.name: map_heat
tools.description: Use when you need a geographic snapshot of where prediction-market attention is concentrated. Returns per-country heat for the current moment (`at=now`) or a past hour (`at=<ISO8601>`). A country's heat is the sum, over its markets that moved in the last 24 hours, of each market's news score |Δprob

tools.name: map_timeline
tools.description: Use when you need the hourly total-heat time series: one point per hour, `total` being the sum of every country's heat at that hour (heat as defined in map_heat). History accretes from launch (no backfill); the whole series comes in one response, with no paging, and grows by one point an hour.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_suggest" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
